items.title: Strict Radial Monotonicity and Multi-Epoch Collision
items.issue: Because theta_cycle is periodic with period 60 years, two years Y and Y + 60k receive identical angles and identical radii in Eq 2. Section 3.2 mentions bounds [0.5, 1.0] for alpha and beta, but does not specify a monotonic epoch coordinate in the Cartesian transformation equation itself.

items.title: TempUN Exact Evaluation Split and Sample Size Undisclosed
items.issue: Paper states 'TempLAMA and TempUN follow their existing splits', but does not disclose the sample size N of evaluated TempUN test cases in Table 1, nor which exact subsets or question types were sampled from the ~9 million items.

items.title: Evaluation Prompts and Decoding Hyperparameters Undisclosed
items.issue: Paper specifies zero-shot and 5-shot evaluation, but omits prompt templates, stop tokens, generation temperature/greedy flag, and the exact response parser regex.

items.title: Target Linear Modules for Parameter Expansion
items.issue: Paper notes incorporating trainable rank-decomposition matrices into each layer, without specifying whether LoRA was applied to attention projection (q, v), all projection matrices, or MLP layers, nor reporting rank r or scaling factor alpha.

items.title: Elastic Weight Consolidation Fisher Estimation
items.issue: Hyperparameter lambda and sample count used to compute the diagonal Fisher empirical information F are omitted.
